slots.name: October 7 death toll
slots.sentence: The Palestinian militant group Hamas led attacks in southern Israel on October 7, 2023 in which some 1,200 people were killed and more than 250 others abducted.

slots.name: Gaza war death toll
slots.sentence: The attacks triggered the ongoing war on Hamas in Gaza, which left some 74,000 Palestinians dead, most of them civilians.
